answer: New identities start in an ivory tier with zero trust, then climb a spiral of verified epochs; forging duplicates means re-paying collateral and redoing that work, so attackers burn capital with no shortcut. Sybil resistance can come from a bonded identity registry: each agent locks collateral in a shared vault and earns reputation only through costly, time-stamped work. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
